Observability._comment_ServiceName: traceId/spanId/service/level are the mandatory fields on every log entry (observability-standards.md); ServiceName is the 'service' field.

Otlp._comment_Endpoint: OpenTelemetry Collector OTLP/gRPC endpoint. Services never ship traces/logs to Tempo/Loki directly (observability-standards.md).

GlobalConfig._comment_Path: Absolute path to a JSON file, outside the repo and never committed, holding this environment's actual ConnectionStrings/Mongo:ConnectionString values (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management). Program.cs layers it on top of this file at startup and fails fast if the path is unset or missing. Local dev sets the concrete path in appsettings.Local.json (see appsettings.Local.json.example); a deployed environment supplies it via the GlobalConfig__Path env var pointing at a mounted secret file.

ConnectionStrings._comment_OfferDatabase: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management). Write-side PostgreSQL - source of truth for Coupon/PricingQuote/PromotionCampaign (database-design.md).

Mongo._comment_ConnectionString: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed. Read-side MongoDB (sharded in production) - the CQRS query side.
